svg.aria-label: A 64-cell KV arena holding two sequences. The donor owns cells 0 to 33 and has written 34 rows. The sharer borrows those 34 rows in place and owns cells 34 to 41 for the 8 rows it wrote itself. Cells 42 to 63 are free in a single run of 22. Releasing the donor while the sharer borrows frees zero cells.
svg.text: the experiment the table on this page reports: a donor writes 34 rows, a sharer borrows all of them and writes 8 more
donor A - its own run, 34 rows written
sharer B - 34 rows borrowed in place, then 8 of its own
free - one run, so free_cells (22) equals the sum of the runs
B's spans are two ranges: positions 0-33 resolve to A's cells 0-33, positions 34-41 to its own cells 34-41.
releasing A while B borrows frees 0 cells - a live share pins its donor's run. Release both and the arena holds 64 free.
the rows a move carries are the ones a sequence wrote itself, which is why B's borrowed prefix travels with A and not with B.
